results.title: OBS Alternative: 5 Easier Streaming Tools for 2026
results.content:
### Can I stream to multiple platforms without OBS?

   

Yes. Browser-based studios and desktop apps with built-in multistreaming can send one stream to several platforms without OBS or plugins. Cloud multistreaming also keeps the load off your computer, because you upload once and the service distributes the stream. OneStream Live, for example, broadcasts from its browser Studio to 45+ platforms at once.

   

### What is the best OBS alternative for Mac?

   

Ecamm Live is the best Mac-native option, with an intuitive interface and guest interviews, but it requires a paid subscription. If you want something free, Meld Studio runs natively on both Intel and Apple Silicon Macs with macOS 12 or later. Browser-based studios also work on any Mac without installing software. [...] Key Takeaways:

 The best OBS alternative depends on your workflow. Browser studios win on setup speed, desktop apps win on control.
 Meld Studio is the strongest free desktop alternative, with built-in multistreaming on Windows and macOS.
 StreamYard suits guest shows, Ecamm Live suits Mac creators, and Streamlabs suits new Twitch streamers.
 OBS is still the right pick for deep scene control, custom plugins and Linux.
 OneStream Live Studio streams from your browser to 45+ platforms, and you can also connect OBS to it as your encoder. [...] ## Pick the OBS Alternative That Fits Your Workflow

The right OBS alternative is the one that removes your biggest bottleneck. If setup and reach slow you down, go browser based with OneStream Live Studio. If you want a free desktop app, try Meld Studio. Streamlabs suits new Twitch streamers, StreamYard handles guest shows, and Ecamm Live fits Mac creators.

Still love OBS? Keep it as your encoder and let OneStream Live handle multistreaming
